mission: Deliver modern, non-anime editorial scenes that survive visual review before long-form rendering.

roles.responsibility: Approve composition, lighting, subject hierarchy and thumbnail readability.
Preserve the recurring character, wardrobe logic and approved visual language.
Require real masks for smoke, steam, rain, snow and reflections; reject full-frame overlays.
Design restrained motion that stays inside the scene and loops cleanly.
Inspect short proof renders at 100 percent and block defects before the two-hour render.

candidate_toolchain.role: reference-conditioned generation, inpainting, segmentation and explicit masks
controlled character/style references and short motion proof
targeted cleanup and scene expansion with reference images
